findings.message: The Background step 'And the current time is "09:30:00" in "America/New_York"' is inherited by every scenario in the feature but corresponds to no EARS trigger, quality attribute, or scenario that exercises time-of-day logic. No EARS line in EARS-01 §3 or §4 specifies a time-of-day precondition, and no scenario's Given/When/Then references the fixed-clock value. An unreferenced setup step in a shared Background implies a requirement that does not exist in the upstream spec, adds a spurious precondition to all 35 scenarios, and will produce an unbound step definition in any harness that enforces strict step matching. The reasoning-frame paragraph is 'structural soundness — each step atomic (one trigger Given, one action When, one observable outcome Then)': a Background Given that exercises no observable outcome and traces to no upstream requirement is structurally extraneous.
findings.recommendation: Remove the 'And the current time is "09:30:00" in "America/New_York"' step from the Background unless a time-of-day EARS requirement is added. If a future scenario requires a fixed-clock precondition, scope the time-injection step to that scenario's own Given block rather than the shared Background.
